aws_agentcore_releasenotes: September 2026 = 5 items (was 4). Literal list:
  1. Harness: Interactive shells (terminals)          [NEW 9/23 — REPORTED]
  2. Harness: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints       (reported 9/22)
  3. Harness: Lifecycle hooks                          (reported 9/22)
  4. Evaluations: TypeScript agent framework support   (reported earlier)
  5. Consent Portal for AgentCore Identity             (reported earlier)
  August 2026 = AWS Agent Registry GA (auto-detection + CMK); Memory IngestData;
    Memory flexible namespaces; Agent Registry PrivateLink  — all previously reported.
  Interactive shells detail: InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell, wss://bedrock-agentcore.<region>
    .amazonaws.com/runtimes/<url-encoded-harness-arn>/ws/shells. Bash only. SigV4 /
    pre-signed URL / bearer via harness inbound authorizer; browser path = base64url token in
    Sec-WebSocket-Protocol. Channels 0x00 STDIN 0x01 STDOUT(PTY) 0x02 STDERR 0x03 STATUS
    0x04 RESIZE 0x05 HEARTBEAT 0xFF CLOSE. Limits: 64KB frame, 250 fps, 1h conn, 10 active
    shells, 20 retained entries, 256KB replay buffer. *** CloudTrail logs the API call only;
    terminal input/output NOT logged anywhere. ***
  UNAUDITED harness subpages (carried 2nd scan — SCHEDULE THIS):
    harness-skills, harness-memory, harness-environment, harness-security (contains the
    authoritative "complete harness permissions model"), harness-versioning, harness-export,
    harness-operations
